scope: Read-only negative failure analysis from saved exported v4 comparison; only this report written. No downloads/installations, relabelling, admissions, split reassignment, threshold changes, model training or model rerun.
observed_summary: All13 accepted-negative original files match raw acquisition, curated negative and archived experiment input hashes. All13 retain existing validation assignments.
All13 failures pass both whole-frame presence gate and V2 localizer. Gate acceptance alone does not establish whole-skirt visibility or separate skirt identity.
Ten source dresses and three source trousers remain visually consistent with existing source category in this agent review; no definite category conflict or separate skirt found.
Ten dress failures show connected bodices; several have gathered/flared lower portions that resemble separate skirt crops.

The three pants failures include cropped striped trousers, a long magenta top over skinny trousers, and a long dark sweater over skinny trousers. Two V2 ROIs cover only hips/upper thighs or long-top hems.
Twelve failures have one visible wearer;5822has a main wearer plus a distant background person. 27837 contains full dress but wearer feet are out of frame.
inferences_not_causal_evidence: Dress-versus-separate-skirt discrimination is a priority: lower dress shape and waist seams can look valid to skirt-oriented features. A controlled torso-context ablation is needed before claiming a mechanism.

Long tops and occluded waists may cause fragment/hip acceptance even when leg separation is visible elsewhere in the original frame. The original frame must remain available for whole-garment identity checks.

Because these validation errors are inspected development examples, they cannot be copied to training or used to tune thresholds while retaining independent validation claims. New related candidate families must be source/group isolated before training.
Backgrounds range across studios, events, streets and gardens; no single background shortcut is established from this failure subset.

reviews.review_method: Actual local original JPEG displayed through view_image individually in this audit; no contact sheet or generated image substituted. All13 displayed at native dimensions returned by tool.

observation.framing: Main wearer head-to-shoes in frame against dark studio-like background.
observation.visible_evidence: Turquoise sleeveless dress has a fitted bodice joined at gathered waist to a flared lower portion. No separate skirt waistband is visible.
observation.roi_observation: V2 ROI starts near waist and contains lower dress and some leg; it excludes neckline and most upper bodice.
observation.hypothesis: Lower flared fabric and folds may resemble a skirt when torso construction is not retained in the localizer ROI. This is a hypothesis, not an attribution result.

semantic_assessment.operational_note: Dress lower portion can look like a skirt, but current target is an actual separate skirt garment; no label change is made.

limitations: Agent review is not independent human ground truth.
Inference scores and ROIs are copied from hash-bound saved comparison; no interpreter or live camera was run in this audit.
This is a selected failure subset, not a new performance evaluation, representative distribution or causality analysis.
No specimen identity verification, garment measurement or Raspberry Pi evidence is added.
